### H4 Scientific Viability Review Summary (`h4_v2`)

- **Verdict**: **`REVISE`**
- **Review Artifacts Written**:
  - [review.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h4_review1/review.txt) (1,495 words)
  - [verdicts.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h4_review1/verdicts.json)

#### Bounded Hypothesis & Scope Narrowing
Relative to [EXTENSIONS.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round5/EXTENSIONS.md#L102-L128) and the superseded V1 pilot ([README.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/results/v1_superseded/README.md#L1-L12)), V2 ([DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DESIGN.md#L23-L34), [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L150-L160)) appropriately narrows the claim from unsupported assertions of "bona fide novel domains", intrinsic disorder, and linker reorientation to testing whether physical cropping and de novo Foldseek search of outcome-independent confident structural regions ($\ge 50\text{ aa}$, 15-aa smoothed $\text{pLDDT} \ge 0.70$) recovers reference-conditional structural matches ($qTM_{crop} \ge 0.5$) in $K_{local}$ versus $K_{dual\_none}$. All inputs in [INPUTS.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/INPUTS.tsv) are accessible and SHA-256 verified, and the physical cropping + Foldseek search pilot (300 models, 413 regions, 12 s walltime) proves full-cohort computational feasibility ($N = 5,851$).

---

#### Critical Issues Requiring Revision

1. **C1 — Post-hoc sequence-identity filtering of `--max-seqs 50` output conflates hit-list saturation with structural match failure in controls (Tiers 2–4)** ([v2_crop_and_search_regions.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L371), [L437–L480](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L437-L480); [v2_region_evaluations.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/results/v2_region_evaluations.tsv); [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L136-L144)):
   - At Tier 2 (`fident < 0.30`) and Tier 3 (`fident < 0.25`), **17/17** and **22/22** of the control regions that lose their Tier 1 match (`100/103 -> 83/103 -> 78/103`) have **zero remaining post-filter hits** rather than low-scoring alignments (`0 < qTM < 0.5` stays constant at `2/103`), with **17/17** (Tier 2) and **21/22** (Tier 3) having `total_hits_raw == 50` (saturating Foldseek's `--max-seqs 50` cap with close homologs). Among control regions retaining $\ge 1$ hit, conditional match rates are **98.04%** (`100/102`, Tier 1), **97.65%** (`83/85`, Tier 2), **97.50%** (`78/80`, Tier 3), and **93.33%** (`70/75`, Tier 4).
   - *Repair*: Separate `POST_EXCLUSION_NO_REMAINING_HIT` from `PERSISTENT_LOW_SCORE` by recording `t{k}_remaining_hits`, report conditional match rates among units retaining hits, and increase `--max-seqs` (e.g., `1000` or `2000`).

2. **C2 — Models with zero eligible confident regions (`n_confident_regions == 0`) are misclassified as Foldseek `ZERO_RETRIEVAL`** ([v2_crop_and_search_regions.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L314-L329), [L497–L521](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L497-L521); [v2_model_summaries.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/results/v2_model_summaries.tsv#L46); [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L159)):
   - Eleven pilot models (`3 K_local`, `4 K_dual_none`, `4 Q_not_K`) have `0` confident regions ($\ge 50\text{ aa}$, smoothed $\text{pLDDT} \ge 0.70$) and were never searched by Foldseek (`cropped_pdb = "NONE"`), yet are classified as `ZERO_RETRIEVAL` (`3/5` of $K_{local}$ and `4/15` of $K_{dual\_none}$ zero-retrieval models in Table 3.2A) and cited in [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L159) as region-level Foldseek k-mer prefilter failures.
   - *Repair*: Separate `NO_CONFIDENT_REGION` (`n_confident_regions == 0`) from `ZERO_RETRIEVAL` (`n_confident_regions >= 1` and `total_hits_raw == 0`) and report both unconditional and region-eligible conditional recovery (`70/97 = 72.16%` vs `15/46 = 32.61%`).

3. **C3 — Exclusion-tier and reference-database asymmetry between whole-chain baseline and cropped evaluation** ([v2_crop_and_search_regions.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L229-L246), [L491–L524](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L491-L524); [control_leakage_audit.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/results/control_leakage_audit.tsv)):
   - Read-only verification of IBEX `05c_screen.sh` confirms identical Foldseek version (`10-941cd33`), PDB database, and search flags (`--alignment-type 1 -e 10 -s 9.5 --max-seqs 50`) as V2 crops, but: (a) `wc_qtm` uses Tier 0 unfiltered scores while crops use Tier 1–4 exclusions (`05c_screen.sh` omitted `fident`), misclassifying 42 self-hit-dependent controls in `--mode full` as `WHOLE_CHAIN_MATCHED`; (b) strata are defined on `PDB + AFDB` while crops are searched against `PDB` only, so `10/100` pilot $K_{local}$ models (`87/936` full) have `whole_chain_pdb_alntm < 0.5` and `20/75` pilot $Q \setminus K$ models (`700/1,807` full) have `whole_chain_pdb_qtm < 0.5`; and (c) the `else: trans_cat = "WHOLE_CHAIN_MATCHED"` branch masks `5/55` $Q \setminus K$ models that lost their PDB match upon cropping.
   - *Repair*: Pin `05c_screen.sh` provenance, match whole-chain and crop exclusion tiers, stratify/restrict $K_{local}$ and $Q \setminus K$ by PDB baseline status, and record crop match retention vs loss for baseline-matched models.

4. **C4 — Unweighted length-stratified pilot estimator for `K_local` vs unstratified comparators** ([v2_crop_and_search_regions.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L254-L263); [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DESIGN.md#L82); [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L120)):
   - Pilot $K_{local}$ ($N=100$) samples 25 models per fixed length bin `[100,200), [200,300), [300,400), [400,10000)` whose population shares ($N=936$) are `13.68%, 46.47%, 24.68%, 15.17%` with recovery rates of `48.0%, 60.0%, 80.0%, 92.0%`. [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L120) reports only the unweighted mean (`70.0%`) rather than the Horvitz–Thompson design-weighted estimate (**`68.15%`**).
   - *Repair*: Disclose length-bin stratification in [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DESIGN.md#L82) and report the Horvitz–Thompson weighted estimate (`68.15%`), or execute the full census (`--mode full`, $N=5,851$).

5. **C5 — Mislabeling of query span as aligned residue count and factual/statistical reporting errors in `DOSSIER.md`** ([v2_crop_and_search_regions.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L408), [L462–L470](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/scripts/v2_crop_and_search_regions.py#L462-L470); [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L40), [L108](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L108), [L131–L145](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L131-L145), [L198](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L198)):
   - `qalnlen = qend - qstart + 1` is query *span*, whereas `84.61%` (`9,516/11,247`) of crop hits have internal target gaps (`alnlen > tspan`; aligned residue pairs = `qspan + tspan - alnlen`).
   - [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L108) mislabels an unpaired $\chi^2$ test ($p = 0.00965 \approx 0.010$) on `117/3,013` vs `159/3,013` as McNemar's test (actual discordant counts $b=0, c=42$, exact McNemar $p = 4.55 \times 10^{-13}$).
   - [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L198) tests region-level proportions (`78/103` vs `19/60`) in Go Criterion 2 instead of model-level units (`56/75 = 74.67%` vs `15/50 = 30.00%`, $p = 1.10 \times 10^{-6}$), and omits Tiers 3–4 from [v2_model_summaries.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/results/v2_model_summaries.tsv).
   - [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L40) ([L145](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h4_v2/DOSSIER.md#L145)) falsely asserts all candidate hits have `<20%` sequence identity (3 candidate region top hits and 97 raw hit rows have `fident >= 0.20`), and Table 3.2B averages `t1_fident` across zero-retrieval regions coded as `0.0`.
   - *Repair*: Compute true aligned pairs (`qspan + tspan - alnlen`) or label `qcov` as span coverage, report exact paired discordant counts ($b=0, c=42$), aggregate Tiers 3–4 to the model level, and correct the sequence-identity statements in `DOSSIER.md`.
